content.title: Why PVH (PVH) Shares Are Trading Lower Today
content.summary: Shares of fashion conglomerate PVH (NYSE:PVH) fell 5.5% in the morning session after Telsey Advisory downgraded the stock to Market Perform from Outperform and cut its price target. The firm lowered its price view on the shares to $82 from a previous $95. The downgrade was based on the assessment that PVH's business was in transition. This move happened as the broader value fashion segment faced intensifying competition, putting pressure on apparel retailers.
